purpose: Prepared acquisition manifests for the 4 named coverage gaps from docs/implementation/data-coverage-matrix-v1.md. Candidate sources, legal fields and verification method only; the owner approves a subset with one decision, then a separate slice performs any download. No bytes are downloaded, reserved or written to any dataset directory by this artifact.
download_destination_when_approved: /Users/unterlantas/Documents/XCode/setos-backend/local-data/SETOS/Datasets/camera-coach/research/<source_family>/ (per AGENTS.md; never inside this iOS repository or Xcode bundles)

allowed_license_classes: CC-BY-SA-* (share-alike accepted for silver-raw research families; per item, receipt required)
no_known_copyright_restrictions (Flickr Commons program; per-photo rights statement required)
forbidden_source_classes: AVA-like MOS / aesthetic-score corpora added for volume (tracker DATA-015 prohibition; docs/cameraanalysis/17-ava-usage-policy-and-pretraining-design.md allows AVA only as isolated Stage-1 pretraining prior, never as release-admissible supervision)
Pexels/Unsplash-style licenses without explicit dataset-redistribution terms
any source whose per-item license cannot be confirmed and receipted at download
policy.label_tier_at_ingest: silver/unlabeled · human_gold=false · release_admissible=false for every family in this manifest; human promotion only via DATA-008..DATA-011 annotation path
policy.synthetic_separation: Gate C1 (docs/implementation/PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.md): organic and synthetic/adversarial cases remain separate buckets (pass_rate >= 0.80 organic vs >= 0.65 synthetic). None of the families below may be merged into an organic bucket alongside synthetic paired-corruptions content.
policy.captured_at_rule: per camera_release_label_v1.schema.json source.captured_at is required and per DATA-005 precedent a missing capture timestamp is never fabricated; items without trustworthy EXIF capture time are excluded at intake or recorded with an explicit exclusion note
policy.cross_manifest_dedup: every accepted item carries content_sha256 plus a stable upstream source_record_key; SHA-256 and source_record_key are checked against existing research/ families (aadb, ava, commons, cinematic, webresearch, open-images-lamp-pilot) to prevent duplicate intake across manifests

per_source_family_required_fields: license_class (family-level expectation; per-item confirmation still mandatory)
attribution_requirements (what the receipt must record per item)
per_item_license_gate (boolean; true means items without confirmed license metadata are rejected, mirroring the existing commons candidates/accepted-rights precedent)
per_item_required_fields_at_download: captured_at (real EXIF only; else item excluded)
license (exact per-item license string from upstream metadata)
human_gold=false, release_admissible=false until DATA-010/011 annotation and adjudication
family_identity_fields_at_download: metadata_sha256 (deterministic aggregate over sorted canonical relative path + logical size + per-file digest of declared content hashes, as defined in receipts/2026-09-22-data-003-local-data-inventory.md)
counts (regular files), logical bytes, M/D/C/L counts per DATA-003 table vocabulary

approval.rationale: Кандидаты одобрены как policy-чистые планы закупки по 4 доказанным coverage gaps. A3/B3 Open Images и C2 COCO одобрены как допустимые альтернативы, но НЕ скачивались: их загрузка требует dataset-scale аннотационных CSV/батчей и не нужна после выполнения квот policy-чистыми поисковыми источниками («не накачивать объём» — строка DATA-015). C3 (owner shot-list съёмка) остаётся планом физической съёмки. Исполненная закупка: Openverse API (агрегатор Flickr Commons/Wikimedia/прочих CC-источников) с per-item license gate: allowlist CC0/PDM/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA, обязательные creator + landing page, лицензия/автор записаны дословно из API, ничего не выдумано.
executed_in_this_slice: C1-класс (organic technical defects) через Openverse search
D1/D2 (tall/square aspects) через Openverse aspect_ratio filter
